blocks.text: Fertilisers (khaad) aise kimiyai maddey hain jo paudon ko barhotri ke liye zaruri ghizai ajza dete aur fasal ki paidawar barhate hain. Yeh kamzor mitti ko dobara bharte, sehatmand barhotri barhate aur behtar khurak ki paidawar yaqeeni banate hain. Masnoi fertilisers kimiyai amal jaise ammonia (NH3) ke Haber-Bosch process se insan banate hain; organic fertilisers qudrati zaraye jaise compost ya janwaron ke gobar se aate hain.

Paudon ko zaruri anasir micronutrients aur macronutrients ki shakal mein chahiye. Bataye gaye micronutrients boron, iron, copper, chlorine, manganese, molybdenum aur zinc hain. Macronutrients carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulphur, potassium, calcium aur magnesium hain. In nau mein se nitrogen, phosphorus aur potassium itni zyada miqdar mein chahiye ke inhein primary macronutrients kehte hain. Tijarati fertilisers par N-P-K ratio likha hota hai, jo in teen anasir ki miqdar batata hai.

blocks.title: Solah diye, satrah kahe
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke paudon ko satrah zaruri anasir chahiye lekin solah ginwati hai (saat micronutrients aur nau macronutrients). Aam taur par satrahwan element nickel shumar hota hai, jo micronutrient hai. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

items: Nitrogen aksar fasal ki paidawar mein sab se mehdood karne wala amil hai. Yeh amino acids ka hissa hai, jo proteins banate hain, aur chlorophyll ka, jo photosynthesis ka rang-maddah hai.
Phosphorus aam taur par superphosphates ya ammonium phosphates ki shakal mein diya jata hai. Yeh ATP (adenosine triphosphate) ka hissa hai, jo tawanai jama aur kharij karta hai.

Potassium, nitrogen aur phosphorus ke bar-aks, paude ki banawat ka hissa nahi banta. Yeh osmoregulator ka kaam karta aur paude ke metabolism mein madad dene wale saath se zyada enzymes ko faal karta hai.

blocks.text: Paudon ki jarein yeh kimiyai maddey jazb karti hain. Lekin agar zyada use hon to faltu miqdar daryaon aur jheelon mein beh kar algae ki had se zyada barhotri karti hai, jo aabi zindagi ko nuqsan deti hai. Kuch masnoi fertilisers ka taveel istemal mitti ka pH bhi badal sakta aur mufeed khurdbeeni jandaron ko maar kar mitti ki sehat kharab kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: macronutrients C, H, O, N, P, S, K, Ca aur Mg ke daire, N, P aur K surkh mein primary, aur micronutrients B, Fe, Cu, Cl, Mn, Mo aur Zn ke daire. Darmiyan: teen cards: N, amino acids aur chlorophyll ka hissa; P, superphosphates ya ammonium phosphates ki shakal mein, ATP ka hissa; K, osmoregulator jo saath se zyada enzymes faal karta. Neeche: faltu khaad pani mein beh kar algae barhati; taveel istemal mitti ka pH badalta.
blocks.caption: Paudon ke ghizai ajza aur N, P, K ke kirdar (topic 32.5 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Paudon ko bohat se anasir chahiye, lekin nitrogen, phosphorus aur potassium sab se zyada miqdar mein, isi liye khaad ke label par in ka N-P-K ratio hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Kisan fasalein badal badal kar kyun ugate hain? Har saal aik hi fasal ugane se wahi ghizai ajza khatam hote hain. Fasalon ki gardish (crop rotation) mitti ke ghizai ajza bahal karti aur masnoi khaad ki zarurat kam karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa N-P-K ghizai juz protein banane aur chlorophyll ki tayyari barhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen: yeh amino acids (proteins) aur chlorophyll ka hissa hai.

items: Fertilisers ghizai ajza dete; masnoi (Haber-Bosch NH3) ya organic (compost, gobar).
Primary macronutrients N, P, K; N-P-K label.
Zyadti: algae ki barhotri, mitti ka pH badalna.
